The default-false `StabilityOptions.evaluate_supplied_trials` evaluates the
reconstructed supplied composition and its selected packing coordinate through
the same native energy calculation as ordinary tangent-plane search. The
[retained qualification rows](results/qualification.csv) compare installed-wheel
outputs on the existing neutral and admitted ionic fixtures. The
[native rows](results/native-qualification.csv) extend the existing charged,
pinned-bubble and mole-changing reacting fixtures. Equations and input sources
remain with [the stability analysis](../2026-tpd-phase-discovery/README.md) and
[ALG-STABILITY](../../engine/docs/science/algorithms.md#alg-stability).

{{< include results/qualification-table.md >}}

Minimum replay uses the design's native final-summation scale $S$ and the
criterion $32\varepsilon_{\rm mach}S$. Present-phase zeros use the unchanged
propagated donor uncertainty; the plane/slope correction contributes no
allowance. Public phases and the nearby corrected candidate are checked
separately. The full chemical, electric and pressure identity is checked on the
returned point. Uncertainty estimates are local numerical estimates, not
certified error enclosures or physical uncertainty measurements.

Without supplied packing, the density owner selects the declared Liquid or
Vapor branch at the initial reconstruction. Returned composition, final density
and pressure closure are checked together. With packing, the chart replays that
coordinate and exposes its pressure defect. Input-to-evaluated displacement is
retained separately from final reconstruction displacement. Repeated entries
and unavailable supported-zero and invalid-packing rows keep caller order and
causes. Density-independent charged admission refuses the whole family, even
with packing; a separate neutral-only family remains evaluable.

{{< include results/default-table.md >}}

This is numerical verification at fixed positive temperature and pressure,
using the stated model parameters, feeds and stationary fixtures. Shared-host
paired wall times support the unchanged-work comparison; they do not establish
an isolated speedup. Supplied evaluation performs no optimization or finite
split. No stability or instability conclusion follows, and this work does not
recreate #234's historical candidate snapshots or qualify its historical
comparisons. Independent delivered review remains with the lead; this notebook
has not been promoted for manuscript use.
